profile.headline: Independent Software Developer
profile.summary: Proven professional with strong software design and development skills in multiple programming languages and environments.  Demonstrated ability to capture customer requirements, produce aggressive but attainable project plans, and use appropriate technologies to deliver solutions in an Agile fashion.  An idea generator and collaborator creating cohesive and productive teams that foster innovation.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a proof-of-concept to capture big data from medical devices.  This system collected data via serial interfaces, published big data to a 3rd-party cloud solution (Axeda), implemented device control, and provided reporting features.
•	Designed and led the software implementation of a proof-of-concept to control an operating room workflow, stream and record surgical video to a central server, and capture patient imagery.
•	Designed and led a proof-of-concept to allow health care professionals to organize and view surgical videos and patient imagery.  Implemented the back-end services for this single-page application.
•	This software was written using Java, Spring, Spring MVC, NoSQL, AngularJS, and C++ within a Tomcat environment.

positions.title: Sr. Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Took a leading role in the development of a retail point-of-sale web application.
•	Developed a web-based WYSIWYG designer tool used to dynamically create an Android tablet interface.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Sr. Staff Engineer/Co-Team Lead (Data Dictionary)
•	Implemented Hibernate entity classes and their corresponding Data Access Objects.
•	Designed and developed a custom multitenant-aware data source implementation.
•	In a mentoring role, assisted other development groups with their Hibernate development activities.

Sr. Staff Engineer/Team Lead (Interaction Composer)
•	Made essential contributions to the company’s graphical development tool and execution environment used by customers to create telephony applications.
•	Led an effort that converted legacy applications to the new graphical development tool.  
•	Led an effort that generated SCXML from the source model of a customer’s application.  
•	Led an effort that dynamically generated VXML from a running SCXML application.  
•	Solely designed and developed software that automatically upgraded previous versions of the source model to the currently released version of the model.
•	Innovated, designed, and led the development of a full-featured application debugger.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Staff Engineer/Team Lead (Media Hub Server)
•	Led an effort that provided centralized access to all media retrieved by the company’s software platform.
•	Designed and participated in the implementation of the GUI tools that prepared media for deployment.

Staff Engineer (Omvia Elements)
•	Was a key contributor in this effort to design and implement the company’s next generation software platform and user interface.
•	Created a session EJB that supported generic JDBC and JMS actions within a heterogeneous transaction. 

Staff Engineer (Host Interfaces & Rapid Development)
•	Served as a contributing software engineer responsible for writing interfaces to various host systems for the company’s software platform. 
•	Designed and implemented a highly flexible, generic MQSeries interface in C++ that supported nearly every feature of MQSeries.  
•	Developed a generic ATMI Tuxedo interface in C++ that supported request/response and conversational processing.  

Staff Engineer (Technical Services)
•	Served as the department’s database expert, assisting customers and co-workers in database design and use.  
•	Developed a generic, client/server interface that allowed our systems to access the PeopleSoft human resources product.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
Project Leader (Information Technology)
•	Led a four person software team that developed and supported the division’s information system.  
•	Worked with customers and upper management to align on key deliverables for the project.  

Application Developer (Quality Metrics)
•	Performed application development using Sybase, CGI with Perl and C, in a UNIX environment.  
•	Served as the Sybase database administrator; designed and implemented database solutions.  
•	Designed and developed a client/server application for worldwide problem reporting.

Software Design Engineer (VER)
•	Was the lead support person for a UNIX-based software solution used to verify integrated circuit designs.  
•	Coordinated all customer support activities, assigned tasks to project members, and ensured resolution of customer problems.  
•	Implemented enhancements and bug fixes to existing production software written in C.

Programmer Analyst (Contracts)
•	Implemented and sustained a large IMS mainframe software system written in COBOL that utilized DL/1 and DB2 databases.  
•	Served as the project database administrator.
